entries.label: HELLO_BEFORE_AMBUSH_1
entries.body:
Attention unidentified space vessel!
Be Warned! This slave world and its inhabitants belong to the Ur-Quan.
I am Starbase Commander Talana of the slave planet Gaia.
Your ship is not responding to standard Hierarchy identification sequences.
You are therefore classed as Independent and... WHAT?!
Is my monitor display correct?!
Is that a human commanding that vessel?
Who are you?

entries.translation:
身分不明的太空船艦， 注意！
警告你！這個奴隸世界及其 居民皆屬於烏爾關。
我是奴隸行星蓋亞的星際基 地指揮官塔拉娜。
你的船並未回應階序的標準 身分識別程序。
因此你被歸類為獨立勢力， 而且……什麼？！
我的螢幕顯示正確嗎？！
指揮那艘船的是人類嗎？
你是誰？

entries.label: HELLO_BEFORE_AMBUSH_2
entries.body:
Hello again, pleasant Human.
It warms me to greet you again.
entries.source:
Hello again, pleasant Human.
It warms me to greet you again.
entries.translation:
又見面了，親切的人類。
能再次向你問候， 令我心中溫暖。

entries.label: HELLO_BEFORE_AMBUSH_3
entries.body:
Welcome back, Earthling.
What do you wish of us?
entries.source:
Welcome back, Earthling.
What do you wish of us?
entries.translation:
歡迎回來，地球人。
你希望我們做什麼？

entries.label: HELLO_BEFORE_AMBUSH_4
entries.body: Yes, Captain?
entries.source: Yes, Captain?
entries.translation: 什麼事，船長？

entries.label: we_are_vice_squad
entries.body: We're the Ethics Police. Justify that costume... Immediately!
entries.source: We're the Ethics Police. Justify that costume... Immediately!
entries.translation: 我們是道德警察。 立刻為那身服裝提出合理解 釋！

entries.label: OK_VICE
entries.body:
Huh? What ARE you talking about?
This is the uniform of a Syreen Commander.
The climate aboard this starbase is maintained at a constant 22 degrees C.
What are we supposed to wear in here... parkas?
entries.source:
Huh? What ARE you talking about?
This is the uniform of a Syreen Commander.
The climate aboard this starbase is maintained at a constant 22 degrees C.
What are we supposed to wear in here... parkas?
entries.translation:
蛤？你到底在說什麼？
這是賽琳指揮官的制服。
這座星際基地內的氣候恆定 維持在攝氏 22 度。
不然我們在這裡該穿什 麼……厚大衣嗎？

entries.label: we_are_the_one_for_you_baby
entries.body: I am the right one for you, baby!
entries.source: I am the right one for you, baby!
entries.translation: 寶貝，我才是你的真命天 子！

entries.label: MAYBE_CAPTAIN
entries.body:
Ah, yes... I had almost forgotten the sophistication of human social graces.
Manners were never the Earthlings' strong point, were they?
Your species' undeniable appeal can be found... elsewhere.
entries.source:
Ah, yes... I had almost forgotten the sophistication of human social graces.
Manners were never the Earthlings' strong point, were they?
Your species' undeniable appeal can be found... elsewhere.
entries.translation:
啊，沒錯……我差點忘了人 類社交禮數有多麼高明。
禮貌從來都不是地球人的強 項，對吧？
你們物種不可否認的魅 力……顯然另有所在。

entries.label: we_are_vindicator0
entries.body: I am Captain
entries.source: I am Captain
entries.translation: 我是

entries.label: we_are_vindicator1
entries.body: of the flagship
entries.source: of the flagship
entries.translation: 船長，指揮旗艦

entries.label: WELCOME_VINDICATOR0
entries.body: Hello Captain
entries.source: Hello Captain
entries.translation: 你好，

entries.label: WELCOME_VINDICATOR1
entries.body: from the Starship
entries.source: from the Starship
entries.translation: 船長，歡迎你與星艦

entries.label: we_are_impressed
entries.body: We're... we're.. we're greatly impressed!
entries.source: We're... we're.. we're greatly impressed!
entries.translation: 我、我們……我們非常佩 服！

entries.label: SO_AM_I_CAPTAIN
entries.body:
So am I, Captain. So am I.
Earthlings are so... so... earthy!
entries.source:
So am I, Captain. So am I.
Earthlings are so... so... earthy!
entries.translation:
我也一樣，船長。 我也一樣。
地球人就是這麼……這 麼……有地球味！

entries.label: HOW_CAN_YOU_BE_HERE
entries.body:
But you haven't answered my question fully.
Why are you here? Where are you from?
Has the slave shield been lifted from Earth?
Are the Ur-Quan finally defeated?
Simply put, Captain...what do you want from us?
entries.source:

Has the slave shield been lifted from Earth?
Are the Ur-Quan finally defeated?
Simply put, Captain...what do you want from us?
entries.translation:
但你還沒有完整回答我的問 題。
你為何來這裡？ 你來自何方？
地球的奴役護盾已經解除了 嗎？
烏爾關終於被擊敗了嗎？
簡單說，船長…… 你希望從我們這裡得到什 麼？

entries.label: we_here_to_help
entries.body: We have come here to free you from slavery to the Ur-Quan!
entries.source: We have come here to free you from slavery to the Ur-Quan!
entries.translation: 我們來這裡，是要讓你們擺 脫烏爾關的奴役！

entries.label: NO_NEED_HELP
entries.body:
Look friend, I appreciate your offer, but we don't want your help.
Why? I'll tell you why
because we're not going to do anything to antagonize the Ur-Quan. That's why.
We may not like slavery, but it's a damn sight better than our alternatives.
Below us we have a beautiful world... maybe it's not Syra, but at least it's a home.
That's a lot more than we ever had before the War... before the Ur-Quan became our masters.

entries.translation:
聽著，朋友，我感謝你的提 議，但我們不需要協助。
為什麼？我告訴你原因
因為我們絕不會做任何激怒 烏爾關的事。原因就是這麼 簡單。
我們或許不喜歡被奴役， 但怎麼說都比其他下場好太 多了。
我們腳下有個美麗世界…… 也許它不是賽拉， 但至少是個家。
這已遠勝於戰爭前…… 烏爾關成為主人以前， 我們所擁有的一切。

entries.label: we_need_help
entries.body: To be honest, we need your help to destroy the Ur-Quan.
entries.source: To be honest, we need your help to destroy the Ur-Quan.
entries.translation: 老實說，我們需要你們協助 摧毀烏爾關。

entries.label: CANT_GIVE_HELP
entries.body:
Look Captain... I like you... even though you're an obnoxious human... I like you.
In another time, we might have become good friends... perhaps more
but that's a fantasy, and my job is dealing with reality.
We're not going to do anything to jeopardize what we've got here.
We've come too far... lost too much, to ever risk losing Gaia, our new home.
Don't get all judgmental on me, Captain... you don't know what we've been through.

聽著，船長……我喜歡 你……即使你是個討人厭的 人類……我還是喜歡你。
如果生在不同時代， 我們或許能成為好友…… 甚至不只如此
但那只是幻想， 而我的工作是面對現實。
我們不會做任何危及眼前生 活的事。
我們走得太遠…… 失去太多，絕不能再冒險失 去新家蓋亞。
別急著批判我，船長…… 你不知道我們經歷過什麼。

entries.label: i_need_you
entries.body: Hey, baby... what I need is you!
entries.source: Hey, baby... what I need is you!
entries.translation: 嘿，寶貝……我需要的就是 你！

entries.label: OK_NEED
entries.body:
Look. Human. Get this through your head.
Under other circumstances, I might be interested in your antics, you're kind of cute
but we've got a serious situation here and we don't have time to fool around.
Our lives are at stake, and so are yours. If the Ur-Quan discover that you have been here
I don't know what they will do to us... much less you!
Now get serious... please.

聽著。人類。把這件事牢牢 記進腦袋。
換個情況，我也許會有興趣 陪你胡鬧，畢竟你還挺可愛
但我們正面臨嚴重情勢， 沒時間打情罵俏。
我們的性命危在旦夕， 你也一樣。若烏爾關發現你 來過這裡
我不知道他們會怎麼對付我 們……更別說你！
現在認真一點……拜託。

entries.label: i_need_touch_o_vision
entries.body: What I need right now, is a Touch-o-Vision.
entries.source: What I need right now, is a Touch-o-Vision.
entries.translation: 我現在需要的是一套觸感視 界。

entries.label: know_about_deep_children
entries.body: Talana, have you ever heard of the `Deep Children?'
entries.source: Talana, have you ever heard of the `Deep Children?'
entries.translation: 塔拉娜，你聽過「深淵之 子」嗎？

entries.label: WHAT_ABOUT_DEEP_CHILDREN
entries.body:
Yes, I think so. Aren't they part of the Mycon religion somehow?
We have recordings of Mycon HyperWave transmissions from the War... pretty weird stuff.
The Mycons just kind of.. rambled, never making much sense.
They talked a lot about `Deep Children', and `Spears of Light',
but we couldn't ever understand what they were talking about.

entries.translation:
有，我想聽過。 它們好像是邁康宗教的一部 分，對吧？
我們保存著戰爭時期的邁康 超波通訊錄音…… 內容相當詭異。
邁康總是有點…… 漫無邊際地說個不停， 幾乎毫無道理。
他們經常談到「深淵之子」 和「光之矛」，
但我們始終無法理解那究竟 是什麼意思。

entries.label: mycons_involved
entries.body: What if I told you that Mycon Deep Children shatter planet crusts... like your Syra?
entries.source: What if I told you that Mycon Deep Children shatter planet crusts... like your Syra?
entries.translation: 如果我告訴你， 邁康的深淵之子會擊碎行星 地殼……就像你們的賽拉 呢？

entries.label: WHAT_PROOF
entries.body:
What?! What did you say?!
Human, you had better not be joking. Syra is not a subject for Earth humor.
Now what do you mean, shatter planet crusts? How?
That IS what happened to Syra, yes, but we presumed it was a natural cataclysm... a meteor.
Do you have proof that it was something else... these Deep Children?

entries.translation:
什麼？！你說什麼？！
人類，你最好不是在開玩 笑。賽拉不是地球式幽默能 拿來消遣的題材。
你說擊碎行星地殼是什麼意 思？怎麼辦到？
那「確實」是賽拉的遭遇， 沒錯，但我們以為是自然災 變……一顆隕石。
你有證據顯示另有原因…… 是這些深淵之子嗎？

entries.label: have_no_proof
entries.body: I don't have proof YET, but I am certain the Mycons destroyed your world.
entries.source: I don't have proof YET, but I am certain the Mycons destroyed your world.
entries.translation: 我「還」沒有證據， 但我確信邁康摧毀了你們的 世界。

entries.label: NEED_PROOF
entries.body:
Captain, if what you say is true, it would turn my world upside down.
You have no sorrow to match what each of us Syreen feels every day of our lives
when we remember what we have lost... Syra... our Eden.
The very idea that the Mycons, or any alien race, may have been responsible for Syra's destruction
fills me with BURNING RAGE!
If it were true, none of us here would rest until we had avenged ourselves on the perpetrators.
We would find some way leave this starbase, locate our starships, and hunt down the evil monsters!
Captain, if you ever gather proof of what you say, you MUST inform us immediately.
But until then... do not mention the subject again. It is too painful.

船長，如果你說的是真的， 我的世界將徹底翻轉。
我們賽琳每天想起失去的一 切時，都承受著無可比擬的 悲痛
……賽拉……我們的伊甸 園。
想到邁康或任何外星種族可 能要為賽拉的毀滅負責
我就滿腔怒火！
如果這是真的， 在向凶手復仇以前， 我們任何人都絕不休息。
我們會設法離開這座星際基 地，找回船艦， 獵殺那些邪惡怪物！
船長，如果你找到證明自己 說法的證據，就「必須」立 刻通知我們。
但在那之前…… 別再提起此事。 這實在太痛苦了。

entries.label: have_proof
entries.body: Talana. I have brought proof that the Mycon Deep Children destroyed your world Syra.
entries.source: Talana. I have brought proof that the Mycon Deep Children destroyed your world Syra.
entries.translation: 塔拉娜，我帶來證據了。 邁康的深淵之子摧毀了你們 的世界賽拉。

entries.label: SEE_PROOF
entries.body: Let me see this proof, Captain!
entries.source: Let me see this proof, Captain!
entries.translation: 讓我看看證據，船長！

entries.label: look_at_egg_sacks
entries.body: Look at these fungal egg sacks. We found them near a crustal puncture on a shattered world.
entries.source: Look at these fungal egg sacks. We found them near a crustal puncture on a shattered world.
entries.translation: 看看這些真菌卵囊。 我們在一個破碎世界的地殼 穿孔附近找到了它們。

entries.label: HORRIBLE_TRUTH
entries.body:
Great gods! These fragments... they are IDENTICAL to the debris we found near the punctures on Syra!
We never guessed that the fragments might be organic!
To have survived re-entry!... nothing organic would remain!... unless
UNLESS, it was genetically constructed for this purpose!
AND ONLY THE MYCONS POSSESS THIS CAPABILITY!!
THE MYCONS WILL PAY DEARLY FOR THEIR CRIMES!!!
We will not sit here and do nothing while the Mycon fiends are free to roam the galaxy, perpetrating their evil.
You wanted our cooperation in fighting the Ur-Quan. You've got it... 
provided you first help us seek our revenge against the Mycon race... help us to destroy them!

偉大的諸神啊！這些碎 片……與我們在賽拉穿孔附 近找到的殘骸「完全相 同」！
我們從沒想過那些碎片可能 是有機物！
竟能在重返大氣層時存留下 來！……任何有機物都不可 能殘存！……除非
「除非」它經過基因建構， 本來就是為此而生！
而「只有邁康具備這種能 力」！！
「邁康必將為自己的罪行付 出慘痛代價」！！！
我們絕不會坐視不管， 任由邁康惡魔在銀河四處遊 蕩、繼續作惡。
你希望我們協助對抗烏爾 關。我們答應…… 
但你必須先協助我們向邁康 種族復仇……幫助我們摧毀 他們！

entries.label: what_doing_here
entries.body: So, Commander Talana, what are you doing here?
entries.source: So, Commander Talana, what are you doing here?
entries.translation: 所以，塔拉娜指揮官， 你在這裡做什麼？

entries.label: OUR_NEW_WORLD
entries.body:
When the Ur-Quan conquered us, over twenty years ago
I was only a young girl living in Habitat Thirty-One.
My older sister, Diani, was a starship officer in the Space Patrol
she was part of the final defense at Raynet... she didn't make it back.
When the Ur-Quan caught us in open space, we all thought we were going to die
but then, instead of killing us, the Ur-Quan offered us a choice
we could join the ranks of their combat thralls, or we could be slave-shielded in our homeworld.
Like the people of Earth, we choose peace. We became fallow slaves.
When the Ur-Quan told us to return to our homeworld, we explained that we had none.
Ur-Quan Master Nine explained that they had encountered this situation before
and if we would provide them with a list of our requirements
they would use their extensive astronomical datastores to find a planet for us!
So we told them about Syra... about the color of its sky... about the abundant lifeforms,
about the fertility of the soil and seas.
Less than an hour later, we received a terse message from Master Nine
we were to proceed to these coordinates and disembark. This was to be our new home.
But our new world, Gaia, was everything we described.
We'd been searching for a home planet for seventy-five years
and in the end, it was our enemies who gave one to us.
I grew up on a small island off the main continent, and like all of my people
we lived each day under the sick, red glow of the slave shield.
When the Ur-Quan arrived seven years ago to refurbish and recrew this starbase
I was selected as the new commander.

二十多年前，烏爾關征服我 們時
我只是住在三十一號棲居站 的小女孩。
姊姊迪亞妮是太空巡防隊的 星艦軍官
她參與了雷奈特的最後防 線……再也沒有回來。
烏爾關在開放太空攔住我們 時，所有人都以為死定了
但烏爾關沒有殺害我們， 反而提出選擇
我們可以加入他們的戰奴行 列，或在母星上受到奴役護 盾封鎖。
就像地球人民， 我們選擇和平， 成為閒置奴隸。
烏爾關命令我們返回母星 時，我們解釋自己已經無家 可歸。
烏爾關九號主宰說明， 他們以前遇過同樣情況
只要我們列出所有需求
他們就會利用龐大的天文資 料庫，替我們尋找一顆行 星！
於是我們向他們描述賽 拉……天空的顏色…… 豐富的生命，
還有土壤與海洋充沛的孕育 力。
不到一小時後， 我們收到九號主宰的簡短訊 息
命令我們前往這組座標下 船。這裡將成為新家。
而新世界蓋亞， 確實具備我們描述的一切。
我們尋找母星找了七十五年
結果卻是敵人送給我們一個 家。
我在主大陸外的一座小島長 大，和所有族人一樣
每天都活在奴役護盾病態的 紅光下。
七年前，烏爾關抵達， 翻修這座星際基地並補充船 員
而我獲選成為新任指揮官。

entries.label: what_about_war
entries.body: So what happened to you at the end of the war?
entries.source: So what happened to you at the end of the war?
entries.translation: 戰爭結束時，你們後來怎麼 了？

entries.label: ABOUT_WAR
entries.body:
When we first met your people, we'd been wandering through the stars for almost seventy-five years,
ever since the death of Syra... our home planet.
We joined your Alliance, and I use the word `joined' loosely, because we had no other choice.
The VUX were raiding our slow Habitat columns, and we had nowhere else to go.
We fought for survival, Captain. Nothing more.
When your people on Earth were defeated, the Alliance just plain fell apart.
The Yehat and Shofixti retreated to their native stars and didn't want us to follow.
The Arilou, those creepy little weasels, just plain bugged out -- vanished
leaving us alone, with nowhere to go, smack in the path of the oncoming Ur-Quan Armada.
What were we supposed to do? Fight? Two-thirds of our Habitat fleet was unarmed!
Many aren't even super-luminal.
We were going to be annihilated if we resisted, and we knew it.
When the Ur-Quan surrounded us and started giving orders that all ended with, `Or Die!'
we took them at face value. We obeyed.
In exchange they gave us Gaia, the planet below.
It's a beautiful world, Captain. I wish I could show it to you.
So don't misunderstand me. We love our freedom as much as anybody else
but we've got a good life here, and we don't want to lose it.

entries.translation:
初次遇見你們時， 我族已在群星間漂泊近七十 五年，
從賽拉……我們的母星死亡 後便一直如此。
我們加入你們的聯盟——我 對「加入」一詞用得相當寬 鬆，因為我們別無選擇。
VUX 不斷劫掠我們行動遲緩的棲 居艦隊列，而我族無處可 去。
我們是為了生存而戰， 船長。沒有其他理由。
你們地球人戰敗後， 聯盟直接分崩離析。
耶哈特與索菲克斯提撤回故 鄉群星，也不願讓我們跟 隨。
阿里盧那些令人發毛的小鼬 鼠，乾脆溜之大吉——消失 無蹤
留下我們孤立無援、 無處可去，正好擋在烏爾關 艦隊逼近的路上。
我們還能怎麼辦？戰鬥嗎？ 棲居艦隊有三分之二未配備 武器！
許多甚至無法超光速航行。
我們知道，只要抵抗就會遭 到殲滅。
當烏爾關包圍我們， 開始下達每句都以「否則就 死！」結尾的命令
我們照字面理解， 選擇服從。
作為交換，他們把下方行星 蓋亞交給了我們。
那是個美麗世界，船長。 真希望能帶你去看看。
所以別誤會。我們和任何人 一樣熱愛自由
但我們在這裡過得不錯， 不想失去這一切。

entries.label: help_us
entries.body: If you love freedom and hate the Ur-Quan, why won't you help us?
entries.source: If you love freedom and hate the Ur-Quan, why won't you help us?
entries.translation: 既然你們熱愛自由又憎恨烏 爾關，為什麼不幫助我們？

entries.label: WONT_HELP
entries.body:
Like I said before, Captain, we would like to help
but we are unwilling to risk losing Gaia.
Unless you can find a much more compelling reason for us to get involved
you are on your own.
entries.source:
Like I said before, Captain, we would like to help
but we are unwilling to risk losing Gaia.
Unless you can find a much more compelling reason for us to get involved
you are on your own.
entries.translation:
就像我之前說過的，船長， 我們願意幫忙
但不願冒著失去蓋亞的風 險。
除非你能找到更具說服力的 理由，讓我們介入
否則只能靠你自己。

entries.label: what_about_history
entries.body: Would you tell me a bit about your people and your culture?
entries.source: Would you tell me a bit about your people and your culture?
entries.translation: 可以告訴我一些你們民族與 文化的事嗎？

entries.label: BEFORE_WAR
entries.body:
Our species are almost identical, almost too close a match to be just a coincidence.
Our bodies are very similar, Captain.
Ha! ha! Except for... certain parts...
Our cultural development is also mostly parallel.
Like you Earthlings, we evolved a society from primitive tribes
whose main function were to protect themselves from the large reptiles native to our old world.
The main difference between our two sets of cultures... the split in the paths of our development
occurred in what would have been your prehistory, say 5000 BCE.
In your world, the agricultural communities were conquered by the more primitive but also more aggressive, migratory herding peoples.
This led to a particular kind of sexual and political dominance structure
which pervaded almost all of your Earth Cultures until the early Twenty First century.
On Syra, our only primitive migratory tribes were confined to our mountainous regions.
Their herd beasts, the Yma, did not do well in the agricultural basins and plains
The two cultures were isolated until much later
when the technological superiority of the farmers curtailed any major conflict.

entries.translation:
我們兩個物種幾乎完全相 同，甚至相似得不像只是巧 合。
船長，我們的身體非常接 近。
哈！哈！除了…… 某些部位……
文化發展也大致平行。
和你們地球人一樣， 我族社會源自原始部落
這些部落的主要功能， 是保護自己不受舊世界原生 大型爬蟲攻擊。
兩套文化之間最主要的差 異……我族發展道路的分岔 點
發生在你們所謂的史前時 代，大約西元前 5000 年。
在你們的世界， 農業社群被更原始、 但也更具侵略性的游牧民族 征服。
這導致一種特殊的性別與政 治支配結構
幾乎滲透所有地球文化， 直到 21 世紀初期。
在賽拉，我們唯一的原始游 牧部落受限於山區。
他們放牧的伊瑪獸無法適應 農業盆地與平原
兩種文化因此隔絕到很晚的 時期
屆時農民的科技優勢已足以 遏止任何重大衝突。

entries.label: what_about_homeworld
entries.body: What was Syra like?
entries.source: What was Syra like?
entries.translation: 賽拉是什麼樣的世界？

entries.label: ABOUT_HOMEWORLD
entries.body:
It was our paradise, Captain, our Eden.
Earth is the only world we know of whose variety and richness of life even comes close to Syra.
Again, like so many other things about our two species, our worlds were very much the same
at least before you began encasing yours in concrete and plastic.
Syra's gravity was a bit lighter than Earth's, and its day was fifty percent longer.
Our diurnal cycle is therefore different from yours.
We spend twenty hours awake, followed by ten hours... horizontal.

entries.translation:
那是我們的天堂，船長， 我們的伊甸園。
在已知世界中， 只有地球的生命多樣性與豐 饒程度堪與賽拉相比。
同樣地，就像兩個物種之間 的許多其他事物， 我們的世界也極為相似
至少在你們開始用混凝土與 塑膠包覆地球以前。
賽拉的重力比地球稍弱， 一天的長度則多出百分之五 十。
因此，我族的晝夜作息與你 們不同。
我們會清醒二十小時， 接著十小時……橫躺。

entries.label: what_happened
entries.body: What happened to Syra?
entries.source: What happened to Syra?
entries.translation: 賽拉發生了什麼事？

entries.label: DONT_KNOW_HOW
entries.body:
This subject is very difficult for us, Captain,
but I will try to recount those sad days.
Like your solar system, ours had a large population of comets and asteroids.
Large meteor impacts, though rare, were not unheard of on our planet.
So it was not a total shock when an asteroid penetrated our atmosphere and hit the surface.
What was odd was that unlike most other meteors, this one was not pulverized on impact.
It penetrated the crust, and indeed went all the way through to the mantle
causing a `super volcano'.
The earthquakes caused by the impact were severe.
The magma pumped out of the caldera wreaked significant damage on the nearby terrain
but within a few weeks, it had cooled, forming a solid rock bandage over the wound.
Within a few months we had cleaned up the mess, the caldera was calming down nicely
and things were pretty much back to normal.
Then, just over a year after the impact, all hell broke loose on the surface of Syra.
Huge calderas were opening all over... not just around the meteor impact, but everywhere!
The scope of the disaster is impossible to imagine
Entire cities sliding into oceans of molten lava
kilometer-wide sections of land pulverized by a cataclysmic explosion
and clouds of poison gas and superheated steam created a death shroud around Syra.

entries.translation:
船長，這個話題對我們極為 沉重，
但我會試著回憶那些悲傷的 日子。
就像你們的太陽系， 我們的星系也有大量彗星與 小行星。
大型隕石撞擊雖然罕見， 卻並非從未在母星發生。
所以小行星穿透大氣層、 撞上地表時，我們並未完全 震驚。
奇怪的是，它不像大多數隕 石那樣在撞擊時粉碎。
它貫穿地殼，甚至一路深入 地函
引發了一座「超級火山」。
撞擊造成的地震極為嚴重。
岩漿從破火山口噴湧， 重創附近地形
但幾週後便冷卻， 形成堅固的岩石繃帶， 覆住傷口。
幾個月內，我們已收拾殘 局，破火山口也逐漸穩定
一切差不多恢復正常。
接著，就在撞擊發生一年多 後，賽拉地表爆發了全面煉 獄。
巨大破火山口在各處張 開……不只隕石撞擊點周 圍，而是無所不在！
災難規模完全超乎想像
整座城市滑入熔岩之海
寬達數公里的陸地遭災變爆 炸粉碎
毒氣雲與過熱蒸氣形成死亡 裹屍布，籠罩賽拉。

entries.label: what_about_outfit
entries.body: Come on now, isn't that outfit, knife included, a bit absurd?
entries.source: Come on now, isn't that outfit, knife included, a bit absurd?
entries.translation: 說真的，那身服裝連刀子都 算進去，不覺得有點荒謬 嗎？

entries.label: HOPE_YOU_LIKE_IT
entries.body:
Maybe some other time, Captain, I can show you the hidden functionality of my uniform
knife included!
entries.source:
Maybe some other time, Captain, I can show you the hidden functionality of my uniform
knife included!
entries.translation:
也許改天，船長， 我可以讓你看看這套制服隱 藏的功能
包括刀子！

entries.label: where_mates
entries.body: What happened to the males of your species?
entries.source: What happened to the males of your species?
entries.translation: 你們這個物種的男性怎麼 了？

entries.label: MATES_KILLED
entries.body:
When Syra was destroyed, the only people who survived were in orbit
and most of them were members of our newly established, mostly female, Space Patrol.
From their ships, their orbital platforms and their lunar outposts they watched Syra die.
Within three days after the cataclysm began, the surface temperature of Syra had risen by almost 75 degrees
to above the boiling point of water.
It became clear that Syra, our paradise, our Eden, was gone.
The survivors spent years in orbit. They made a few missions to the surface
and actually found a handful of survivors, but their main activity was preparations for departure.
The Space Patrol fitted makeshift drive units to anything that could hold air
orbital factories, research pods, even hotels. When the fleet was ready, they left orbit and never looked back.
The final population of our species was less than ten thousand, with only five hundred males
but they were the best and the brightest.
For the next seventy-five years, our people wandered at sub-light speed through the stars
looking for a new home.

entries.translation:
賽拉毀滅時，只有身處軌道 的人活了下來
而他們大多是剛成立、 成員以女性為主的太空巡防 隊。
他們從船艦、軌道平台與月 面前哨站目睹賽拉死亡。
災難開始後三天內， 賽拉的地表溫度上升近 75 度
超過水的沸點。
很明顯，賽拉——我們的天 堂、伊甸園——已經消逝。
倖存者在軌道上生活了數 年。他們幾度前往地表
確實找到少數生還者， 但主要工作仍是準備離開。
太空巡防隊替所有能密封空 氣的東西裝上臨時推進器
軌道工廠、研究艙， 甚至旅館。艦隊準備完成後 便離開軌道，再也沒有回 頭。
我族最後的人口不到一萬， 其中男性僅有五百名
但他們都是最優秀、 最聰明的一群。
接下來七十五年， 我族以低於光速的速度漂泊 群星
尋找新的家園。

entries.label: get_lonely
entries.body: Don't you ever get... lonely? Hmmm?
entries.source: Don't you ever get... lonely? Hmmm?
entries.translation: 你難道從來不會覺得…… 寂寞嗎？嗯？

entries.label: MAKE_OUT_ALL_RIGHT
entries.body:
Ha! ha! ha! Don't worry about us, Captain!
We make out all right.
entries.source:
Ha! ha! ha! Don't worry about us, Captain!
We make out all right.
entries.translation:
哈哈哈！別替我們擔心， 船長！
我們「親熱」得挺好的。

entries.label: bye
entries.body: Goodbye, Commander Talana. I will be back.
entries.source: Goodbye, Commander Talana. I will be back.
entries.translation: 再會，塔拉娜指揮官。 我會回來。

entries.label: GOODBYE
entries.body: Until then, Earthling.
entries.source: Until then, Earthling.
entries.translation: 後會有期，地球人。

entries.label: MUST_ACT
entries.body:
Captain. The secret of the Mycon's monstrous murder of our planet has changed the attitudes of many of my people.
We will not sit here and do nothing while the Mycon fiends are free to roam the galaxy, perpetrating their evil.
You wanted our cooperation in fighting the Ur-Quan. You've got it... provided
you first help us seek our revenge against the Mycon race... help us to destroy them!

entries.translation:
船長，邁康殘酷謀殺我族行 星的祕密，已改變許多族人 的態度。
我們絕不會坐視不管， 任由邁康惡魔在銀河四處遊 蕩、繼續作惡。
你希望我們協助對抗烏爾 關。我們答應…… 但有個條件
你必須先協助我們向邁康種 族復仇……幫助我們摧毀他 們！

entries.label: whats_next_step
entries.body: Okay. So what do you want us to do?
entries.source: Okay. So what do you want us to do?
entries.translation: 好。那你希望我們怎麼做？

entries.label: OPEN_VAULT
entries.body:
Our first step is to get some mobility.
We have some fine starship officers on board, and they are all eager to go after the Mycons,
but without our Penetrator starships, we're totally ineffectual.
So our first step HAS to be recovering our Space Patrol combat fleet.
We know that the Ur-Quan didn't destroy them... they never waste anything
but we believe they have sealed them in some kind of deep vault in the surface of an alien planet.

entries.translation:
第一步是取得行動能力。
基地裡有一些優秀的星艦軍 官，每個人都迫不及待想追 殺邁康，
但沒有穿透艦， 我們完全發揮不了作用。
所以第一步「必須」是取回 太空巡防隊戰鬥艦隊。
我們知道烏爾關沒有摧毀它 們……他們從不浪費任何東 西
但我們相信，那些船被封存 在某顆外星行星地表的深層 庫房裡。

entries.label: where_is_it
entries.body: Do you know where your ships are?
entries.source: Do you know where your ships are?
entries.translation: 你知道自己的船在哪裡嗎？

entries.label: DONT_KNOW_WHERE
entries.body:
No, that's your job.
But maybe we have some clues to help you find them.
The starship officers who flew the Penetrators to the vault did so with total sensor black-out.
The only thing they could use for navigation was the presence of the Dreadnought fleet surrounding them.
When they arrived at their destination and lowered their ships into the immense vault
they were transported to the Dreadnoughts and only caught a split-second glimpse of the outside world.
As far as they could tell, the sun was either red or orange. Based on their trip-time calculations
the farthest they could have travelled is about 200 HyperSpace distance units.
entries.source:
No, that's your job.
But maybe we have some clues to help you find them.
The starship officers who flew the Penetrators to the vault did so with total sensor black-out.
The only thing they could use for navigation was the presence of the Dreadnought fleet surrounding them.
When they arrived at their destination and lowered their ships into the immense vault
they were transported to the Dreadnoughts and only caught a split-second glimpse of the outside world.
As far as they could tell, the sun was either red or orange. Based on their trip-time calculations
the farthest they could have travelled is about 200 HyperSpace distance units.
entries.translation:
不知道，那是你的任務。
不過，我們也許能提供一些 線索協助你尋找。
把穿透艦開往庫房的星艦軍 官，當時所有感測器都完全 關閉。
唯一能用來導航的， 就是包圍他們的無畏艦艦 隊。
抵達目的地並將船降入巨大 庫房後
他們被送上無畏艦， 只來得及瞥見外界不到一 秒。
根據當時所見， 那顆恆星不是紅色， 就是橙色。按照航程時間推 算
他們最遠大約航行了 200 個超空間距離單位。

entries.label: been_there
entries.body: I've already been there. The vault is on the moon of Epsilon Camelopardalis I, but I couldn't open it.
entries.source: I've already been there. The vault is on the moon of Epsilon Camelopardalis I, but I couldn't open it.
entries.translation: 我已經去過了。 庫房就在鹿豹座艾普西隆 I 的衛星上，但我打不開。

entries.label: GREAT
entries.body: Wonderful! Then the job is already almost complete!
entries.source: Wonderful! Then the job is already almost complete!
entries.translation: 太好了！那麼任務已經幾乎 完成！

entries.label: GIVE_SHUTTLE
entries.body:
Captain! We have assembled a small team of our most skilled officers.
we will send them to your ship on board their own small shuttle.
We feel that in the interests of efficiency, we keep our officers away from your crew
at least until the mission is over.
As soon as you arrive at the Vault, our people will take over, figure out a way to open the Vault
and bring our Penetrators back here.

entries.translation:
船長！我們已召集一支由最 優秀軍官組成的小隊。
她們會搭乘自己的小型接駁 艇，前往你的船。
為了提高效率， 我們認為該讓軍官遠離你的 船員
至少在任務結束前如此。
你一抵達庫房， 我們的人便會接手， 設法開啟庫房
並把穿透艦帶回這裡。

entries.label: im_on_my_way
entries.body: Very well then, Commander Talana. I'm on my way.
entries.source: Very well then, Commander Talana. I'm on my way.
entries.translation: 那就這麼辦，塔拉娜指揮 官。我現在出發。

entries.label: doing_this_for_you
entries.body: Just remember, I'm doing this for you Sweet Cakes!
entries.source: Just remember, I'm doing this for you Sweet Cakes!
entries.translation: 只要記住，我都是為了你才 這麼做，小甜心！

entries.label: if_i_die
entries.body: If I die... just remember that I... I... really like you!
entries.source: If I die... just remember that I... I... really like you!
entries.translation: 如果我死了…… 只要記得我……我…… 真的很喜歡你！

entries.label: GOOD_LUCK
entries.body:
Good luck, brave Earthling. When your mission is successful
maybe then we can... get to know each other better.
entries.source:
Good luck, brave Earthling. When your mission is successful
maybe then we can... get to know each other better.
entries.translation:
祝你好運，勇敢的地球人。 等任務成功後
也許我們就能…… 更深入地了解彼此。

entries.label: OK_FOUND_VAULT
entries.body:
Good, now we can proceed with our plan for REVENGE against the Mycon!
From our analysis of the Deep Child fragments you showed to us
and a review of the recorded Mycon transmissions from the War
we have established the kind of world the Mycons desire for their hideous Deep Children.
They need a planet like your Earth... or our Syra... one rich in water and oxygen
and possessing a molten, active mantle.
Our plan is to lure the Mycons to such a planet, and then attack them when they least expect it.
We know of just such a world.
When the Ur-Quan were analyzing their mass of planetary data to find a new home for my people
one of the close candidates, ranked just below Gaia, was a blue world orbiting close to the star, Organon.
Captain, we need your services again. Here is what you must do.
You must go to the Mycon and tell them of this world.
They will find that the world is suitable, and when they go to Organon
we shall be there... waiting for them.
Then we shall destroy them!

entries.translation:
很好，現在可以執行向邁康 「復仇」的計畫！
分析你展示的深淵之子碎片
並重新檢視戰爭期間留下的 邁康通訊紀錄後
我們確認了邁康想替醜陋的 深淵之子尋找哪種世界。
他們需要類似你們地球…… 或我族賽拉的行星…… 有豐富水與氧氣
並擁有熔融而活躍的地函。
我們的計畫是把邁康引到這 樣的行星，再趁他們毫無防 備時攻擊。
我們正好知道一個符合條件 的世界。
烏爾關分析大量行星資料、 替我族尋找新家時
有個藍色世界是僅次於蓋亞 的候選地點，它緊鄰奧加農 星運行。
船長，我們再次需要你的服 務。你必須依照以下指示行 動。
前往邁康，告訴他們這個世 界。
他們會發現這顆行星符合需 求；等他們前往奧加農
我們就會在那裡…… 等著他們。
然後將其摧毀！

entries.label: what_now
entries.body: Are you sure the Mycon are going to fall for this? Why should they believe me?
entries.source: Are you sure the Mycon are going to fall for this? Why should they believe me?
entries.translation: 你確定邁康會上鉤嗎？ 他們為什麼要相信我？

entries.label: HERES_THE_PLAN
entries.body:
For all their evil, Captain, the Mycon are a naive race.
They have great difficulty understanding deception.
If you tell them what they wish to hear, they will believe you.
entries.source:
For all their evil, Captain, the Mycon are a naive race.
They have great difficulty understanding deception.
If you tell them what they wish to hear, they will believe you.
entries.translation:
船長，邁康雖然邪惡， 卻是個天真的種族。
他們極難理解欺騙。
只要說出他們想聽的話， 他們就會相信你。

entries.label: whats_my_reward
entries.body: So! What if I die doing all this dangerous stuff? What about... us?
entries.source: So! What if I die doing all this dangerous stuff? What about... us?
entries.translation: 那麼！如果我做這些危險的 事時死了呢？我們…… 怎麼辦？

entries.label: HERES_REWARD
entries.body:
I'm afraid BOTH our duties will be dangerous, Captain.
We may never see each other again.
But for now, at least, there's this...
entries.source:
I'm afraid BOTH our duties will be dangerous, Captain.
We may never see each other again.
But for now, at least, there's this...
entries.translation:
恐怕「我們雙方」的任務都 很危險，船長。
也許再也無法見面。
但至少現在，我們還有這 個……

entries.label: bye_after_vault
entries.body: I'll miss you, Talana.
entries.source: I'll miss you, Talana.
entries.translation: 我會想念你，塔拉娜。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AFTER_VAULT
entries.body: Don't worry, my human. We will be together again... some day.
entries.source: Don't worry, my human. We will be together again... some day.
entries.translation: 別擔心，我的人類。 總有一天……我們會再次相 聚。

entries.label: HELLO_AFTER_AMBUSH_1
entries.body:
SUCCESS, Captain! The Mycons' fleet is in shambles!
JUSTICE IS OURS!
We have revenged ourselves against the heinous Mycons!
They fell for our trap so completely!
When they approached Organon I, we were hiding behind its moon.
As they approached, their ships broke combat formation
in preparation for their hideous implanting ceremony.
We waited until they were fully dispersed around the planet, then we attacked!
The standard Mycon tactic would have been to speed out of orbit using a gravity whip maneuver
but the Podships refused to abandon their slow-moving Deep Children spore pods.
They remained in the gravity well, and WE SLICED THEM TO RIBBONS!
They must have lost a dozen ships to their own stupidity... running into their own Plasmoids!
The rest?... well we took care of most of them... in our own special way.
and Captain, now that we have taken our revenge on the Mycon
we give you our starship officers and Penetrator designs so that you can add our ships
to your fleet.

entries.translation:
成功了，船長！ 邁康的艦隊已潰不成軍！
「正義屬於我們」！
我們已向罪大惡極的邁康復 仇！
他們徹徹底底落入陷阱！
他們接近奧加農 I 時，我們正藏在它的衛星後 方。
對方靠近後，船艦打破戰鬥 隊形
準備進行醜惡的植入儀式。
我們等到他們完全散布在行 星周圍，接著發動攻擊！
邁康的標準戰術， 原本應該利用重力彈射迅速 脫離軌道
但孢子艦不肯拋棄行動緩慢 的深淵之子孢子莢。
他們留在重力井裡， 而「我們把他們切成了碎布 條」！
他們肯定因自身愚蠢損失了 十幾艘船……竟撞上自己發 射的電漿體！
剩下的呢？……嗯， 我們用自己的特殊手段解決 了大部分……
而船長，既然如今已向邁康 復仇
我們會把星艦軍官與穿透艦 設計圖交給你， 讓你能將我方船艦
編入自己的艦隊。

entries.label: HELLO_AFTER_AMBUSH_2
entries.body:
Hello brave Earthling. Your return is welcome.
My people, the Syreen, shall be forever in your debt.
In fact, many of my officers wish to thank you... personally... for your efforts on our behalf.
I suggest you set aside a week sometime in the near future
so that you can properly receive your hero's welcome aboard this starbase.

entries.translation:
你好，勇敢的地球人。 歡迎回來。
我的民族賽琳將永遠欠你一 份恩情。
事實上，許多軍官都想親 自……感謝…… 你為我們所做的努力。
我建議你近期找個時間空出 一星期
這樣才能在星際基地上， 好好接受英雄應有的款待。

entries.label: HELLO_AFTER_AMBUSH_3
entries.body:
Oh, Captain! The flush of victory still has my body quivering!
For so many years we have dreamed of putting the death of our beloved homeworld behind us
and now this has finally come to pass!
We no longer live in the past... caught in memories of what COULD have been.
Now each of us plans for the future... toward the bright tomorrow!
And you know what, Captain?
I have plans... Plans you would be most interested in hearing
but I shall save them for later... when we can meet... privately.

entries.translation:
噢，船長！勝利的興奮至今 仍使我全身顫抖！
這麼多年來，我們一直夢想 著放下摯愛母星死亡的悲痛
如今終於實現了！
我們不再活在過去…… 困於「本來可能」發生的想 像。
現在所有人都在規劃未 來……奔向明亮的明天！
你知道嗎，船長？
我也有些計畫…… 你一定會非常有興趣聽聽
但我會留到以後…… 等我們能夠…… 私下見面時再說。

entries.label: HELLO_AFTER_AMBUSH_4
entries.body:
Ah! My beautiful Captain from Earth!
What can I do for you... please tell me.
entries.source:
Ah! My beautiful Captain from Earth!
What can I do for you... please tell me.
entries.translation:
啊！我來自地球的俊美船 長！
我能為你做什麼…… 請告訴我。

entries.label: what_now_after_ambush
entries.body: Is there anything else I can do to you - um! - I mean, do FOR you.
entries.source: Is there anything else I can do to you - um! - I mean, do FOR you.
entries.translation: 還有什麼是我能對你做的— —呃！——我是說， 能「為」你做的。

entries.label: DO_THIS_AFTER_AMBUSH
entries.body:
Captain, the next step is to pull down the slave shield from our planet.
In my opinion, the only people who could do that are the Chenjesu
and as far as I know, they are under a shield of their own.
Actually... I'm just dodging the real issue, Captain.
Your agenda really has only one item... Destroy the Ur-Quan Hierarchy!
How to do that? I'm not sure
but I know you can't take them head-on, even with that amazing ship of yours.
You will have to find their weak spot, and then strike it with everything you've got.

entries.translation:
船長，下一步是解除我族行 星的奴役護盾。
依我看，唯一有能力辦到的 民族是陳傑蘇
而據我所知，他們也被困在 自己的護盾下。
其實……我只是在迴避真正 的問題，船長。
你的行動清單上其實只有一 件事……摧毀烏爾關階序！
該怎麼做？我不確定
但我知道，即使擁有你那艘 驚人的船，也不能正面進 攻。
你必須找出他們的弱點， 再用手上一切力量發動打 擊。

entries.label: what_about_you
entries.body: So what happens to you now?
entries.source: So what happens to you now?
entries.translation: 那你們現在會怎麼樣？

entries.label: ABOUT_ME
entries.body:
I expect I'm going to be pretty busy for the next few months
overseeing repairs to our fleet of Penetrator starships
and preparing some kind of defensive system for this starbase.
If and when the Ur-Quan return here, we want to have a little surprise ready for them.
entries.source:
I expect I'm going to be pretty busy for the next few months
overseeing repairs to our fleet of Penetrator starships
and preparing some kind of defensive system for this starbase.
If and when the Ur-Quan return here, we want to have a little surprise ready for them.
entries.translation:
接下來幾個月， 我大概會非常忙碌
得監督穿透艦艦隊的維修工 作
還要替這座星際基地準備某 種防禦系統。
若烏爾關真的回到這裡， 我們想先備妥一份小驚喜。

entries.label: whats_up_after_ambush
entries.body: So, what's new Talana?
entries.source: So, what's new Talana?
entries.translation: 那麼，塔拉娜， 有什麼新鮮事？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_AFTER_AMBUSH_1
entries.body:
Not a great deal, Captain. You seem to be the biggest source of excitement around here.
I've had requests from just about every officer under my command
to be transferred to your Earth Starbase to serve under you.
If I wasn't running this Starbase, I'd be first in line.
entries.source:
Not a great deal, Captain. You seem to be the biggest source of excitement around here.
I've had requests from just about every officer under my command
to be transferred to your Earth Starbase to serve under you.
If I wasn't running this Starbase, I'd be first in line.
entries.translation:
沒什麼大事，船長。 你似乎是這一帶最大的刺激 來源。
幾乎每位受我指揮的軍官都 提出申請
希望調往你的地球星際基 地，在麾下效力。
要不是我得管理這座星際基 地，早就第一個排隊了。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_AFTER_AMBUSH_2
entries.body:
We have been intercepting a concentration of Hierarchy broadcasts
but we cannot translate their content.
They all appear to be originating from the direction of the Horologii constellation.
entries.source:
We have been intercepting a concentration of Hierarchy broadcasts
but we cannot translate their content.
They all appear to be originating from the direction of the Horologii constellation.
entries.translation:
我們攔截到大量階序廣播
但無法翻譯內容。
它們似乎全都來自時鐘座方 向。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_AFTER_AMBUSH_3
entries.body: Nothing new to report, Captain.
entries.source: Nothing new to report, Captain.
entries.translation: 沒有新情況可回報，船長。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_AFTER_AMBUSH_4
entries.body: Nothing new to report, Captain.
entries.source: Nothing new to report, Captain.
entries.translation: 沒有新情況可回報，船長。

entries.label: bye_after_ambush
entries.body: Goodbye Talana.
entries.source: Goodbye Talana.
entries.translation: 再會，塔拉娜。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AFTER_AMBUSH
entries.body: Goodbye my human.
entries.source: Goodbye my human.
entries.translation: 再會，我的人類。

entries.label: FOUND_VAULT_YET_1
entries.body: Have you found the ship vault yet?
entries.source: Have you found the ship vault yet?
entries.translation: 你找到船艦庫房了嗎？

entries.label: FOUND_VAULT_YET_2
entries.body: Any success finding our ships, Captain?
entries.source: Any success finding our ships, Captain?
entries.translation: 找到我方船艦了嗎，船長？

entries.label: vault_hint
entries.body: Er... no. Have you got any idea where it is, even a guess?
entries.source: Er... no. Have you got any idea where it is, even a guess?
entries.translation: 呃……還沒。你知道它大概 在哪裡嗎？猜測也行。

entries.label: OK_HINT
entries.body: Only that the vault is at a red or maybe orange star, and not too far from our position.
entries.source: Only that the vault is at a red or maybe orange star, and not too far from our position.
entries.translation: 只知道庫房位於紅色、 也可能是橙色恆星附近， 離我們這裡不會太遠。

entries.label: found_vault
entries.body: Yes! We found it on the moon of Epsilon Camelopardalis I.
entries.source: Yes! We found it on the moon of Epsilon Camelopardalis I.
entries.translation: 有！我們在鹿豹座艾普西隆 I 的衛星上找到了！

entries.label: bye_before_vault
entries.body: Goodbye, Talana. I'm off to find the vault!
entries.source: Goodbye, Talana. I'm off to find the vault!
entries.translation: 再會，塔拉娜。 我要去找庫房了！

entries.label: GOODBYE_BEFORE_VAULT
entries.body: Good luck, Captain.
entries.source: Good luck, Captain.
entries.translation: 祝你好運，船長。

entries.label: what_do_i_get_for_this
entries.body: So what do I get for this, eh? Hmm? Eh?
entries.source: So what do I get for this, eh? Hmm? Eh?
entries.translation: 所以，我能得到什麼回報？ 嗯？怎樣？嗯？

entries.label: GRATITUDE
entries.body: You will receive more gratitude than you know what to do with, Captain.
entries.source: You will receive more gratitude than you know what to do with, Captain.
entries.translation: 船長，你會得到多到不知該 如何消受的感謝。

entries.label: not_sure
entries.body: Uh... I'm just not sure. This sounds dangerous.
entries.source: Uh... I'm just not sure. This sounds dangerous.
entries.translation: 呃……我實在不確定。 這聽起來很危險。

entries.label: PLEASE
entries.body: Please, Captain, we need your help!
entries.source: Please, Captain, we need your help!
entries.translation: 拜託，船長，我們需要你協 助！

entries.label: READY_FOR_AMBUSH
entries.body: We will wait here for the Mycons.
entries.source: We will wait here for the Mycons.
entries.translation: 我們會留在這裡等待邁康。

entries.label: repeat_plan
entries.body: Could you repeat the plan again?
entries.source: Could you repeat the plan again?
entries.translation: 可以再說一次計畫嗎？

entries.label: OK_REPEAT_PLAN
entries.body:
Ok, here's the plan, again.
You must go to the Mycons and tell them about a world at the Organon star system.
Tell them that you have found the perfect world for their hideous Deep Children.
We will hide there and wait for them in ambush.
Then we shall destroy them.
entries.source:
Ok, here's the plan, again.
You must go to the Mycons and tell them about a world at the Organon star system.
Tell them that you have found the perfect world for their hideous Deep Children.
We will hide there and wait for them in ambush.
Then we shall destroy them.
entries.translation:
好，再說一次計畫。
你必須前往邁康， 告訴他們奧加農星系有個世 界。
說你已替他們醜惡的深淵之 子找到完美世界。
我們會躲在那裡， 設伏等候。
接著將他們摧毀。

entries.label: bye_before_ambush
entries.body: Good luck, Talana.
entries.source: Good luck, Talana.
entries.translation: 祝你好運，塔拉娜。

entries.label: GOODBYE_BEFORE_AMBUSH
entries.body: Same to you, my human.
entries.source: Same to you, my human.
entries.translation: 你也一樣，我的人類。

entries.label: what_about_us
entries.body: I guess what I mean is... What about us, Talana?
entries.source: I guess what I mean is... What about us, Talana?
entries.translation: 我真正想問的是…… 我們之間怎麼辦，塔拉娜？

entries.label: ABOUT_US
entries.body:
I'm afraid our duties will keep us apart, Captain
But for now, at least, there's this...
entries.source:
I'm afraid our duties will keep us apart, Captain
But for now, at least, there's this...
entries.translation:
恐怕職責會使我們分隔兩 地，船長
但至少現在，我們還有這 個……

entries.label: MORE_COMFORTABLE
entries.body:
That's more like it... now 
let me help you off with this
yes... now aren't you a lot more comfortable?
entries.source:
That's more like it... now 
let me help you off with this
yes... now aren't you a lot more comfortable?
entries.translation:
這樣才像話……現在 
讓我幫你脫掉這個
沒錯……現在是不是舒服多 了？

entries.label: in_the_spirit
entries.body: I see! Well, in the spirit of interspecies communication, let me just say, COWABUNGA!
entries.source: I see! Well, in the spirit of interspecies communication, let me just say, COWABUNGA!
entries.translation: 我懂了！好吧， 秉持物種間交流的精神， 我只想說：卡哇邦嘎！

entries.label: OK_SPIRIT
entries.body:
Oooh! Say that word again!
It makes me feel so excited!
It makes me want to do something nice for you
like this...
and this...
and especially, this!
entries.source:
Oooh! Say that word again!
It makes me feel so excited!
It makes me want to do something nice for you
like this...
and this...
and especially, this!
entries.translation:
噢！再說一次那個詞！
它讓我覺得好興奮！
讓我想為你做些美好的事
像這樣……
還有這樣……
尤其是，這樣！

entries.label: what_in_mind
entries.body: Hey... what have you got in mind here?
entries.source: Hey... what have you got in mind here?
entries.translation: 嘿……你打算在這裡做什 麼？

entries.label: SOMETHING_LIKE_THIS
entries.body:
Well to start off, I thought we'd do something like this
unless your species isn't limber enough
and then I thought we could move on to something a bit more like... Mmmm... this.
and after you have recovered, I thought this might be fun!
and if you're still conscious, I thought we could try this
even though I've never done it before!
entries.source:
Well to start off, I thought we'd do something like this
unless your species isn't limber enough
and then I thought we could move on to something a bit more like... Mmmm... this.
and after you have recovered, I thought this might be fun!
and if you're still conscious, I thought we could try this
even though I've never done it before!
entries.translation:
嗯，首先，我想我們可以做 點像這樣的事
除非你們這個物種的身體沒 那麼柔軟
接著，我想可以繼續做更接 近……嗯……這樣的事。
等你恢復過來， 我想這個應該也會很好玩！
如果你還有意識， 我想我們可以試試這個
雖然我以前從沒做過！

entries.label: hands_off
entries.body: Hey! Hands off lady! I'm not THAT kind of Captain.
entries.source: Hey! Hands off lady! I'm not THAT kind of Captain.
entries.translation: 嘿！女士，別動手動腳！ 我「不是」那種船長。

entries.label: OK_WONT_USE_HANDS
entries.body:
Oh, Captain... I would never think of doing something unpleasant to you
quite the opposite in fact.
But if you want me to keep my hands off... I can use other... things...
like this over here...
and this right here...
and this right about here.
entries.source:
Oh, Captain... I would never think of doing something unpleasant to you
quite the opposite in fact.
But if you want me to keep my hands off... I can use other... things...
like this over here...
and this right here...
and this right about here.
entries.translation:
噢，船長……我絕不會想對 你做任何不舒服的事
事實上正好相反。
但如果你希望我別動手…… 也可以用其他……東西……
像這邊這個……
還有這裡這個……
以及差不多這個位置的這 個。

entries.label: why_lights_off
entries.body: Ahh... why are the lights off?
entries.source: Ahh... why are the lights off?
entries.translation: 啊……燈為什麼關了？

entries.label: LIGHTS_OFF_BECAUSE
entries.body:
Because, my darling, if the light was on, I couldn't do this...
or this...
or this...
or, umm... this.
entries.source:
Because, my darling, if the light was on, I couldn't do this...
or this...
or this...
or, umm... this.
entries.translation:
因為，親愛的， 要是開著燈，我就沒辦法做 這個……
或這個……
或這個……
又或者，嗯……這個。

entries.label: evil_monster
entries.body: You're not going to turn into some weird alien monster now, and bite my head off, are you?
entries.source: You're not going to turn into some weird alien monster now, and bite my head off, are you?
entries.translation: 你不會現在突然變成什麼古 怪外星怪物，一口咬掉我的 腦袋吧？

entries.label: NOT_EVIL_MONSTER
entries.body:
Ha!-ha!-ha! An alien monster? Me?
ME?! WHY CAAPTAIN! WHYEVER DOO YOOU SAAY THAAAT!!!
REEAARRGGGG!!!!
...just kidding!
entries.source:
Ha!-ha!-ha! An alien monster? Me?
ME?! WHY CAAPTAIN! WHYEVER DOO YOOU SAAY THAAAT!!!
REEAARRGGGG!!!!
...just kidding!
entries.translation:
哈！哈！哈！外星怪物？ 我嗎？
「我」？！船～～長！ 你～～怎麼～～會這樣說～ ～！！！
吼啊啊啊！！！！
……開玩笑的！

entries.label: disease
entries.body: Very funny. Look, I'd be more comfortable if we just turned the lights back on.
entries.source: Very funny. Look, I'd be more comfortable if we just turned the lights back on.
entries.translation: 真好笑。聽著， 把燈重新打開， 我會比較自在。

entries.label: JUST_RELAX
entries.body: Just relax, my silly human Captain. Let me take care of everything.
entries.source: Just relax, my silly human Captain. Let me take care of everything.
entries.translation: 放輕鬆，我傻氣的人類船 長。讓我處理一切。

entries.label: what_happens_if_i_touch_this
entries.body: Hmmm... what happens if I do this?
entries.source: Hmmm... what happens if I do this?
entries.translation: 嗯……如果我這麼做， 會發生什麼事？

entries.label: THIS_HAPPENS
entries.body:
...mmm
MMMm!...
Ohh!...
...MMMMMmmmmmm!!!...
does that answer your question?
entries.source:
...mmm
MMMm!...
Ohh!...
...MMMMMmmmmmm!!!...
does that answer your question?
entries.translation:
……嗯
嗯嗯！……
噢！……
……嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯 嗯！！！……
這回答了你的問題嗎？

entries.label: are_you_sure_this_is_ok
entries.body: Are you sure this is okay? I'm nervous.
entries.source: Are you sure this is okay? I'm nervous.
entries.translation: 你確定這樣沒問題嗎？ 我很緊張。

entries.label: YES_SURE
entries.body:
Please don't worry, my darling human
we have all the time in the world
and my door locks securely.
entries.source:
Please don't worry, my darling human
we have all the time in the world
and my door locks securely.
entries.translation:
請別擔心，親愛的人類
我們擁有世上所有時間
而我的房門鎖得非常牢。

entries.label: boy_they_never_taught
entries.body: Boy-oh-boy! They never taught me stuff like this back at Unzervalt!
entries.source: Boy-oh-boy! They never taught me stuff like this back at Unzervalt!
entries.translation: 我的天啊！翁澤沃特從來沒 教過我這種東西！

entries.label: THEN_LET_ME_TEACH
entries.body:
Then let me teach you what you need to know
we will begin with the fundamentals of basic Syreen physiology...
entries.source:
Then let me teach you what you need to know
we will begin with the fundamentals of basic Syreen physiology...
entries.translation:
那就讓我教你需要知道的事
我們從賽琳基礎生理學的根 本開始……

entries.label: not_much_more_to_say
entries.body: Hmm, uh.. well, uh, I guess I don't have much more to say, do I?
entries.source: Hmm, uh.. well, uh, I guess I don't have much more to say, do I?
entries.translation: 嗯，呃……這個，呃， 我想我沒什麼好再說的了， 對吧？

entries.label: THEN_STOP_TALKING
entries.body:
Then stop wasting your lips on words, you silly fool
and come here!...
entries.source:
Then stop wasting your lips on words, you silly fool
and come here!...
entries.translation:
那就別再把嘴唇浪費在說話 上了，你這個小傻瓜
過來吧！……

entries.label: LATER
entries.body: (...several hours later...)
entries.source: (...several hours later...)
entries.translation: （……幾個小時後……）

entries.label: SEX_GOODBYE
entries.body:
Goodbye Captain, darling... we each have our jobs to do
now you must go!
But you will remain always in my mind and heart
and deep within me, I know that someday, when all this madness has come to an end
we will be together like this... again.
entries.source:
Goodbye Captain, darling... we each have our jobs to do
now you must go!
But you will remain always in my mind and heart
and deep within me, I know that someday, when all this madness has come to an end
we will be together like this... again.
entries.translation:
再會了，親愛的船長…… 我們各有職責要完成
現在你必須離開！
但你會永遠留在我的腦海與 心中
而在內心深處， 我知道總有一天， 等這一切瘋狂告終
我們會再次…… 像這樣相聚。

entries.label: OUT_TAKES
entries.body:
In case you were wondering about me... don't worry! I'm doing fine!
In fact, I just talked with the designers and they have assured me
that the sequel will be all about me! Isn't that great!
They said they wanted to move away from the warrior mythos
and expand more into the healer cycle.
This may be my big chance!
The only thing I'm not sure about is the new costume they want me to wear.
They said this one would be REALLY revealing.
entries.source:
In case you were wondering about me... don't worry! I'm doing fine!
In fact, I just talked with the designers and they have assured me
that the sequel will be all about me! Isn't that great!
They said they wanted to move away from the warrior mythos
and expand more into the healer cycle.
This may be my big chance!
The only thing I'm not sure about is the new costume they want me to wear.
They said this one would be REALLY revealing.
entries.translation:
如果你正好想知道我的近 況……別擔心！ 我過得很好！
事實上，我剛和設計師談 過，他們向我保證
續作將完全以我為主角！ 是不是很棒！
他們說想擺脫武士神話
進一步拓展療癒者循環。
這也許是我的大好機會！
唯一讓我不太確定的， 是他們希望我穿上的新服 裝。
他們說這套會「暴露得 多」。
